metadata.purpose: Storage probe E1 (v1): adding a NULLABLE column must preserve existing rows. Uses KeepExistingIfCompatible and forbids destructive recreate -- a probe that recreates cannot test preservation, which is the entire point of this one.
metadata.seedPath: Rows are seeded through the generated app's own CRUD endpoint, which is why this concept carries a ui label: without one the app emits no such endpoint and Tier C's seed 404s. Inserting over JDBC instead would prove the rows survive, but not that the platform wrote them (storage/OPEN_ITEMS_PLAN.md 5.1).
metadata.reservedWordWorkaround: The field is `label`, not `value`, ONLY because `value` is a reserved word in H2 and the generator does not quote business identifiers (ledger STOR-6) -- so this probe could never boot. That is a workaround for the PROBE, not for the platform. Said out loud here because a fixture quietly shaped around a bug is how the bug stops being visible.
